summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' island catalogue — distinct from `agenor-ithaca` in Epitome 7.27 and from the royal and Trojan bearers of the name.

story.text: Apollodorus names Agenor among the wooers assigned to Zacynthus, listed after Clytius and before Polybus in Epitome 7.29.
